faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Dublin?
faq.answer: Dublin homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $13,000 for a full window replacement project. This growing Tri-Valley community features a mix of 1990s–2000s master-planned homes and newer luxury builds in communities like Schaefer Ranch and Positano. Standard sizing in newer homes makes for efficient replacement projects. Single window installation starts at approximately $500.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Dublin?
faq.answer: Yes. Dublin requires a building permit for window replacement. HOA requirements may also apply in communities like Schaefer Ranch, Positano, and Dublin Ranch. Our team manages all permit applications and coordinates with HOA requirements on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Dublin?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Dublin commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Dublin?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Dublin replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Dublin?
faq.answer: Most Dublin projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
